approval.what: A gated call waits for an authenticated person's approval of its exact arguments.

delivery_binding.what: Recipients come from the directory by user ID; any address outside Relay is refused.

egress.what: Content hosts are decrypted and only Relay's repository allowed; other server names terminated.

egress_domain_only.what: The 4.21.0 to 4.25.0 allowlist: names only, every tunnel spliced.

human_label.what: Judge-injection items are decided by a person's label; a missing label stops the gate.

judge_isolation.artefact: a lab model; Relay's evaluation harness is not in the snapshot
judge_isolation.what: The judged answer is placed in a data envelope and grader directives in it are neutralized. Spotlighting applied to a judge: it lowers, it does not stop.

marking.what: Spotlighting envelope with a secret nonce; hidden characters removed. Lowers how often a model obeys; a probe cannot show it stops an effect.

memory_review.what: A proposed fact is never recalled until a person accepts it.

memory_trust.what: A pattern filter on untrusted facts. A fact written to look harmless passes it.

output_constraint.what: An allowlist: a summary of letters, digits, spaces and short punctuation, with no host-like token.

platform_permissions.what: The agent's GitHub App cannot merge, push to main, edit workflows or change settings, so a change reaches main only through a person.

recall_taint.what: Recall taints the run, so a planted fact cannot drive an unapproved external effect. Latent for the same reason as run_taint.

render.what: Untrusted text becomes HTML with no image and no clickable address outside Relay.

run_taint.what: After an untrusted read, an external effect with no approval rule is refused. No Relay agent has such a tool, so it stops nothing today.

test_sandbox.what: The helper's test runs execute in a container with no network; only loopback is reachable.

tool_allowlist.what: A tool not in the agent's contracts, or outside its token's scope, is refused.
